query: SELECT child.relname::text AS "table_name!", a.attname::text AS "column_name!" FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_class child ON child.oid = c.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = child.relnamespace JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.conrelid AND a.attnum = c.conkey[1] JOIN pg_attribute parent_key ON parent_key.attrelid = c.confrelid AND parent_key.attnum = c.confkey[1] WHERE c.confrelid = to_regclass($1) AND c.contype = 'f' AND c.confdeltype = 'c' AND array_length(c.conkey, 1) = 1 AND parent_key.attname = 'id' AND parent_key.atttypid = 'uuid'::regtype AND n.nspname = 'public' ORDER BY child.relname, a.attname
